summary: Gold Fields filed a 6-K attaching a SENS announcement that Quebec's Ministry of the Environment issued the Certificate of Authorisation for the Windfall gold project on 30 October 2026, the principal environmental approval under Chapter II of the Environment Quality Act. The permit allows construction and full development; it follows the June 2026 Uukiimau Impact and Benefit Agreement with the Cree First Nation of Waswanipi. Gold Fields became sole owner via its October 2024 Osisko Mining acquisition. Final Investment Decision remains subject to board approval, targeted with February 2027 provisional results; watch permitting conditions and capex guidance.
